Ekta Chawla
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Ms. Priyanka Agrawal, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. S.C. Dumka, A.G.A. for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for 
respondent no.5.
2. By order dated 02.09.2026, this Court 
had directed the Investigating Officer to 
remain personally present before the Court. In 
compliance with the said order, Sub-Inspector 
Om Prakash Singh, Investigating Officer of the 
concerned case, is present in person. He 
submits that the bullet recovered from the 
body of the deceased, along with the pistol 
recovered from the place of occurrence, was 
sent to the Forensic Science Laboratory 
(F.S.L.) for examination. He further submits 
that the F.S.L. report is likely to be received 
by him by today or tomorrow. He also submits 
that the iPhone belonging to the deceased, 
which was recovered from the spot, was found 
to be locked. The same was initially sent to 
F.S.L., Dehradun, but could not be accessed/
unlocked and was, thereafter, forwarded to 
the Central Forensic Science Laboratory 
(C.F.S.L.), Chandigarh, for examination. The 
report in respect thereof is also likely to be  received within two days.
3. The Investigating Officer submits that, 
upon receipt of the aforesaid forensic reports, 
necessary further investigation shall be 
carried out and the progress thereof shall be 
apprised to the Court on the next date of 
listing.
4. List on 06.10.2026.
5. In view of the Investigating Officer having 
appeared in person and the submissions 
made by him, his personal appearance before 
this Court is dispensed with.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 
 16.09.2026
Arpan
